summary: Shift Cycle Rotator feature fully tested. All backend APIs (PUT /reminders with shift_cycle, GET /today-shift with German/Italian labels and times) working correctly. Frontend shows Schichtzyklus-Rotator section for shift/night workers only, with preset templates, visual cycle editor, today indicator, and start date input all functional.

details: PUT /api/supplement-plan/{profile_id}/reminders accepts shift_cycle with pattern and start_date
FFSSNN-- pattern saved correctly as ['early','early','late','late','night','night','off','off']
When shift_cycle not provided, saved as null
GET /today-shift calculates correct shift based on (today - start_date) % pattern.length
Returns German labels: Fruehschicht, Spaetschicht, Nachtschicht, Frei
Returns Italian labels: Turno mattutino, Turno pomeridiano, Turno notturno, Libero
Returns correct times for each shift type (early: 05:00/11:30/20:00, late: 09:30/15:30/23:00, night: 14:30/20:00/03:00, off: 09:00/12:30/20:00)
Returns null shift with message when no cycle configured
Returns 404 for non-existent profile
Cycle day calculation verified with known start_date
Schichtzyklus-Rotator section VISIBLE for shift_work users when reminders enabled
Schichtzyklus-Rotator section NOT visible for office/homeoffice/physical workers
Schicht-Vorlage (shift preset) section also conditional on work_type
VK 4x4 button visible and populates 16-day pattern (4x early, 4x late, 4x night, 4x off)
3-Schicht button visible
FFSSNN-- button visible and pre-selected when matching saved pattern
2-Schicht button visible
Colored squares displayed: F=orange, S=blue, N=purple, -=gray
Tapping a cycle day square cycles through F->S->N->-
Legend displayed below cycle editor
'Heute: Nachtschicht (Tag 5)' banner shown when cycle configured
Green border highlights current day in visual cycle editor
Start date input field visible with placeholder JJJJ-MM-TT
Value populated from saved cycle (2026-03-01)
Clicking Save button persists shift_cycle to backend
VK 4x4 pattern correctly saved and verified via API
Pattern restored to original FFSSNN-- after test
